meta.disclaimer: Statistical screening only. These numbers are not proof of cheating, and strong or fast players can produce outlier scores. Always review the underlying games and context before drawing conclusions.
meta.demo_label: Synthetic games: Black used a strong local engine against a weak engine opponent. Not a real player.

reasons.title: Low average centipawn loss
reasons.detail: 9.1 cp across 143 analysed moves, versus ~88 cp expected for 1500 blitz. Lower loss means the player's moves stayed closer to the engine's top choices.

reasons.title: Accuracy above the rating baseline
reasons.detail: 98.1% average accuracy versus ~73.5% expected. Accuracy is derived from the win-probability drop of each move.

reasons.title: Frequent engine top-move agreement
reasons.detail: 74.1% of sampled moves matched the engine's first choice, versus ~37.0% expected. This is one of the strongest single signals.

reasons.title: High accuracy with little thinking time
reasons.detail: 140 moves were played quickly and still averaged 98.7% accuracy.
